payload.criterion: bin/aff exists and --help for check and close-batch succeed; bin/se-workflow is gone; Python imports use affidavit not se_workflow
payload.verify_command: test -x bin/aff && ! test -e bin/se-workflow && bin/aff check --help >/dev/null && bin/aff close-batch --help >/dev/null && uv run --with pytest python -m pytest tests/test_aa_resolve.py tests/test_close_batch.py -q --collect-only >/dev/null && python3 -c "import importlib.util as u; import affidavit, affidavit.cli; assert u.find_spec('affidavit'); assert u.find_spec('se_workflow') is None"
